description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component for displaying a selectable row with a visual indicator and an extension for styling views with custom backgrounds and borders based on selection and hover states.

classes.name: SelectionStateIndicator
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a checkmark or arrow icon based on the 'selected' state.

methods.name: openClawSelectableRowChrome
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies custom padding, background, and border styles to create a selectable row appearance.

methods.name: openClawRowBackground
methods.description: A private helper function that determines the background color based on selection and hover states.
